blocks.zh: Sobolev 空间与 Fourier 变换
blocks.label: subsec:sobolev-fourier-characterization

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.en: We now consider Sobolev spaces of all of $\mathbb{R}^m$. Clearly, it follows from Theorem~\ref{thm:fourier-inner-product-preservation} that the Fourier transform maps $L^2(\mathbb{R}^m)$ to itself; indeed, it is an isometry in $L^2(\mathbb{R}^m)$. Moreover, the Fourier transform of $D^\alpha u$ is $(i\bm{\xi})^\alpha\hat u$. Hence we immediately obtain the following result.
blocks.zh: 现在考察整个 $\mathbb{R}^m$ 上的 Sobolev 空间. 显然, 由 Theorem~\ref{thm:fourier-inner-product-preservation} 可知, Fourier 变换将 $L^2(\mathbb{R}^m)$ 映入自身; 事实上, 它是 $L^2(\mathbb{R}^m)$ 中的等距映射. 此外, $D^\alpha u$ 的 Fourier 变换为 $(i\bm{\xi})^\alpha\hat u$. 因而立即得到以下结果.

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.en: The Fourier transform $\mathcal{F}$ is a homeomorphism from $H^k(\mathbb{R}^m)$ onto the weighted space $L_w^2(\mathbb{R}^m)$ (cf. Definition~\ref{def:weighted-lp-two-space}), where $w(\bm{\xi})=1+|\bm{\xi}|^{2k}$.
blocks.zh: Fourier 变换 $\mathcal{F}$ 是从 $H^k(\mathbb{R}^m)$ 到加权空间 $L_w^2(\mathbb{R}^m)$ 上的同胚 (参见 Definition~\ref{def:weighted-lp-two-space}), 其中 $w(\bm{\xi})=1+|\bm{\xi}|^{2k}$.
blocks.label: thm:sobolev-fourier-weighted-homeomorphism

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.en: We shall use the notation $L_k^2$ to denote this weighted $L^2$-space. It is easy to see that $\mathcal{S}(\mathbb{R}^m)$ is dense in $L_k^2(\mathbb{R}^m)$. Theorem~\ref{thm:sobolev-fourier-weighted-homeomorphism} then implies that $\mathcal{S}(\mathbb{R}^m)$, and hence also $\mathcal{D}(\mathbb{R}^m)$, is dense in $H^k(\mathbb{R}^m)$.
blocks.zh: 用记号 $L_k^2$ 表示这一加权 $L^2$ 空间. 容易看出 $\mathcal{S}(\mathbb{R}^m)$ 在 $L_k^2(\mathbb{R}^m)$ 中稠密. 于是 Theorem~\ref{thm:sobolev-fourier-weighted-homeomorphism} 表明, $\mathcal{S}(\mathbb{R}^m)$, 因而还有 $\mathcal{D}(\mathbb{R}^m)$, 在 $H^k(\mathbb{R}^m)$ 中稠密.

blocks.en: Another application of the theorem is the definition of fractional order Sobolev spaces.
blocks.zh: 该定理的另一应用是定义分数阶 Sobolev 空间.

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.en: We say that $u\in H^s(\mathbb{R}^m)$, $s\in\mathbb{R}^+$, if $\mathcal{F}[u]$ is in the weighted $L^2$-space $L_w^2(\mathbb{R}^m)=:L_s^2(\mathbb{R}^m)$ with $w(\bm{\xi})=1+|\bm{\xi}|^{2s}$.
blocks.zh: 若 $\mathcal{F}[u]$ 属于权为 $w(\bm{\xi})=1+|\bm{\xi}|^{2s}$ 的加权 $L^2$ 空间 $L_w^2(\mathbb{R}^m)=:L_s^2(\mathbb{R}^m)$, 则说 $u\in H^s(\mathbb{R}^m)$, $s\in\mathbb{R}^+$.
blocks.label: def:fractional-order-sobolev-fourier
